song_craft: Voice: plain anupAya quatrain (three refusals + pictured-light refused / joy-surge / treasure-equation). Rhyme would gild; bluntness carries.

lines: Bliss here is not wealth-middle-intoxication, nor like enjoying women,
nor lamp-sun-moon-made splendour-multitudes — nor even the light-rise.
Joy — difference gathered, freed in bliss-ground, like the lowering of a burden —
is the forgotten treasure found of the all-nonduality state: the light-rise.
l3.sanskrit_cite: ānandaḥ atra na vittamadhya madavan naivāṅganāsaṅgavat dīpārkendukṛta prabhāprakaravan naiva | prakāśodayaḥ harṣaḥ saṃbhṛtabhedamuktisukhabhūr bhārāvatāropamaḥ sarvādvaitapadasya vismṛtanidheḥ prāptiḥ prakāśodayaḥ
notes: saMbhRta-compound kept whole (one-vs-several open); prakASodaya same-vs-different open (refused first, affirmed last — ring works either way) — BOUNDARY

verses.craft: Via negativa kept whole (wealth, women, splendour, pictured-light — four refusals, none trimmed); burden simile kept bodily (load set down); treasure-equation closes on affirmed light-rise (ring with refused light-rise held open).
verses.rejected: (a) trimming a refusal -> killed: fourfold no is the via negativa. (b) resolving compound / same-vs-different light -> killed by BOUNDARY held-open x2. (c) prettifying burden -> killed: load stays load.
